Resolution on KSEB Privatisation
items.summary: This House resolves that the Government of Kerala should not proceed with the privatisation of Kerala State Electricity Board and take steps to strengthen the public sector undertaking.

items.title: Resolution on Unemployment Allowance
items.summary: This House resolves that the Government of Kerala should introduce a comprehensive unemployment allowance scheme for educated youth who have been unemployed for more than two years.

items.title: Resolution on Farmers Debt Relief
items.summary: This House resolves that the Government of Kerala should implement a comprehensive debt relief scheme for farmers who have taken agricultural loans from cooperative banks and nationalised banks.

items.title: Resolution on Minority Welfare Fund
items.summary: This House resolves that the Government of Kerala should establish a dedicated Minority Welfare Fund with adequate allocation to address the educational and economic needs of minority communities.

items.title: Resolution on IT Sector Employment
items.summary: This House resolves that the Government of Kerala should take steps to attract more IT companies to the State and create at least one lakh new jobs in the IT sector within the next three years.

items.title: Resolution on Rubber Price Support
items.summary: This House resolves that the Government of Kerala should take immediate steps to ensure a minimum support price of Rs. 250 per kg for rubber and provide adequate compensation to rubber farmers.

items.title: Resolution on Metro Rail Extension
items.summary: This House resolves that the Government of Kerala should take steps to extend the Kochi Metro Rail to Aluva and Tripunithura and also initiate metro rail projects in Thiruvananthapuram and Kozhikode.

items.title: Resolution on Fishermen Welfare
items.summary: This House resolves that the Government of Kerala should implement a comprehensive welfare scheme for traditional fishermen including housing, insurance, and pension benefits.

items.title: Resolution on Uniform Civil Code
items.summary: This House resolves that the Government of Kerala should support the implementation of a Uniform Civil Code as directed by the Supreme Court of India.

items.title: Resolution on Cashew Industry Revival
items.summary: This House resolves that the Government of Kerala should take immediate steps to revive the cashew processing industry in the State and provide adequate support to cashew workers.

items.title: Resolution on Madrassa Education
items.summary: This House resolves that the Government of Kerala should take steps to modernise Madrassa education and integrate it with the mainstream education system.

items.title: Resolution on Space Technology Park
items.summary: This House resolves that the Government of Kerala should establish a dedicated Space Technology Park in Thiruvananthapuram to leverage the presence of ISRO and related institutions.
